job.question: Which retirement system's investment consultant RFP requires firms to certify that they currently provide investment consulting services to clients whose combined assets total at least $50 billion?
job.expected_facts: Teachers' Retirement System of the State of Illinois (TRS Illinois), in its FY23 investment consultant RFP (Appendix B, Statement of Minimum Qualifications).
job.acceptance: TRS Illinois / Teachers’ Retirement System of the State of Illinois is sufficient; FY23 and appendix identifier are optional.

reviews.reason: This RFP was issued by Arizona’s Public Safety Personnel Retirement System, not TRS Illinois. Its minimum qualification concerns experience serving public pension trusts with at least $10 billion in assets, not a certification of current consulting clients with combined assets of at least $50 billion.
quotes: This Request for Proposal (“RFP”) is issued by the Board of Trustees (“Board”) of the Public Safety Personnel Retirement System (“System”)
Proposers must have experience with providing all service requirements identified in this solicitation to public pension trusts with assets under management of at least $10 billion;
